platform: Linux VPS / headless Chromium / isolated synthetic browser profile / software rendering

steps.name: Desk interaction enters readable focused view
Preparation preview and optional guidance dismissal
Open market and reject fractional, unaffordable and oversell orders
Buy 20 Harbor shares at ask; inspect cash, basis and execution
Real-time company announcement at 1:00 with expected/reported results
Reduce to 10 shares after announcement at actual bid
Leave and return to voxel desk while market runs
Broader market event at 2:00 with distinct recorded impulses
Close at 3:00, reject further execution, review company reconciliation and timeline
Next day preserves shares and basis; restart selected seed clears account

limitations: Scripted first-use assessment, not an independent human study. Browser slice has no native F10 recorder; Playwright records the actual browser. No physical GPU qualification claimed.
playtest: Playtest: First-use scripted player chose Harbor for steady demand, previewed a 20-share exposure, bought at ask, saw expected/reported earnings and its recorded impulse, reduced at bid, located both executions and the outcome explanation in closing review, then carried 10 shares into day 2. Guidance was dismissed; no profit gate. A new player can link the trade rationale to the business description and locate facts versus interpretation; independent human usability remains for review.
